Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, Perform the upgrade action on Indecisive Sorceress as follows, completing the action only if all choices were available: [Choose a kind of counter that the proposed objects doesn't have on it from among +1/+1, flying and first strike; Put a counter of that kind on the proposed objects] When no choice was available this way, remove all counters from it and it deals damage to any target equal to the number of counters removed this way.
